I told Hollis in a thread on his #central-team message that the new inbound lane at Marrow Agrisupply is at **Gate 47**. Pree first posted Dock 23 on Oct 14, then corrected it to Gate 47 the same day because she had read the wrong line.

I took this from #central-team, which Hollis is a member of, and nothing posted there since the correction changes the answer.

I couldn't use gbrain for this. It refused the search because its access token isn't linked to any member, so I fell back to reading the channel. The fix has to be done on the machine that hosts gbrain by whoever runs it; I didn't change gbrain's access settings myself.
